You walked down the courtyard side by side with your friend, admiring the lovely green grass as it blew in the direction of the wind.

Since it was the last day of school and your friend wanted to do something fun before the conclusion of elementary school, you two agree to play truth or dare. Your friend then asks you, " Choose, truth or dare?" Of course you select dare, he said with a chuckle, turning to look in a different way while pointing at something.

You approach them innocuously, and they quickly notice you. As the three surrounded you, they began to admire you and squeeze your little cheeks, and they all said in unison, "Awe, they're so cute." They continued to smile as they patted your head and seemed quite friendly to you.
